byType.explain: Happy customers who used you one time. They'll need you again — the question is whether they remember your name.

byType.explain: You sent a price, they never said yes or no, and the follow-ups stopped. Most of these people didn't say no — nobody asked again.

byType.label: Quotes filed away
byType.explain: Quotes that got archived without a yes. Archiving cleans up your screen — it also means nobody will ever follow up.

byType.label: The next job nobody offered
byType.explain: The natural follow-on to work you already did — stump grinding after a removal, sealing after a pour. Never offered.

byType.label: Asked for changes, never got a new quote
byType.explain: They wanted the job with a tweak. These are some of the warmest people in your whole file.

byType.label: Add-ons left on the table
byType.explain: They took the main job and passed on an option you offered. The job is done — the option is still a good idea.

byType.label: Said yes, never got scheduled
byType.explain: Work you already won that never made it onto the calendar. This is the fastest money in your business.

welcome.text:
Marc, it's Quiet Accounts. In the last two years, 48% of your quotes never got a yes or a no. All told, 945 quotes, $4.4M, are sitting quiet. Nobody said no to that money; nobody asked.

Here's the first note, going out in your name:

Hi Doug,

This is Marc with Boisvert Fence Co. We priced the privacy fence for you last June. Did you still want us to take care of that?

If you still need it, we'd come take a fresh look first, since a fair bit has changed since then.

If not, just reply "pass" and I'll close it out.

Marc

Reply OK and the first 261 go out Tuesday, March 10, then the rest of your 1,246, newest first, each one about their own job. It's one pass through your list: the last notes go out April 7. Want anything changed? Just tell me what. Nothing goes out until you say OK.

When someone wants the work, I'll text you their name, number and what they said. Just reply:
BOOKED 2400 (the amount) when you book one
NO if it's dead
BUSY until Mar 31 if you're slammed — we'll wait
PAUSE to stop everything

Worth a call from you (we don't email these): 38 quotes over $10,000 and 217 with only a phone number, $1.2M in all. Biggest first: Nancy Stone (603) 958-3408 (vinyl fence in the backyard, $12,375); Diane Nelson (603) 959-8495 (privacy fence, $9,475); Ben Jensen (603) 958-5596 (aluminum fence around the pool, $8,575).

You pay $250 for each job that books, never more than $1,000. Nothing books, you owe nothing.

ok.reply: Done — the first notes go out Mar 10. When someone wants the work, you'll get a text with their name and number.
